set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set chassis fpc [parameter1].explanation: Sets the specified parameter for a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) in the Junos chassis, configuring hardware-specific behavior or operational state.

pic [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) and its associated Physical Interface Card (PIC) in a Junos device, specifying parameters for hardware settings.

e1 [parameter3].explanation: This command configures an E1 interface on a specific Physical Interface Card (PIC) within a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) in a Junos device.

channel-set [parameter4].explanation: The `channel-set [parameter4]` command in Junos configures a T1/E1 interface to use specific timeslots (specified by `[parameter4]`) for channelized operation.

timeslot-list [parameter5].explanation: The `timeslot-list [parameter5]` command in Junos specifies the time slots (channels) to be used for a T1/E1 interface, where `[parameter5]` defines the slot numbers.

parameters.name: timeslot-list
parameters.explanation: list, specify the gap range to be used.

loopback-type [parameter4].explanation: The `loopback-type [parameter4]` command in Junos configures the type of loopback interface, where `[parameter4]` specifies the loopback mode (e.g., `internal`, `external`).

parameters.name: loopback-type
parameters.explanation: Ringback type, e.g. remote means long-range ringback.

deactivate chassis fpc [parameter1].explanation: The command deactivates the specified Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) slot `[parameter1]`, disabling its functionality and removing it from the operational state.

pic [parameter2].explanation: The command `pic [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the Physical Interface Card (PIC) slot number for configuration or operational mode tasks.

e1 [parameter3].explanation: The command `e1 [parameter3]` in Junos configures an E1 interface with specific settings defined by `[parameter3]`, such as framing, clocking, or channel-group parameters.

loopback-type [parameter4].explanation: The `loopback-type [parameter4]` command in Junos configures the type of loopback interface, where `[parameter4]` specifies the loopback mode (e.g., `ethernet`, `sonet`).

parameters.name: loopback-type
parameters.explanation: Ringback type, e.g. remote means long-range ringback.
